item: The serve_canary thread bridge is dropped from the GET side-effect walk
summary: Finding F4 is fixed in #1556 (the rollup canary's interrupt timer is named rollup-canary-timer), so the walk's monitor no longer skips an unnamed thread started from serve_canary: a bare Thread-N from there is recorded again, rollup-canary-timer joins the duckdb-gated columnar thread allowance, and the unit test asserts the started threads' own names. Measured: both GET ratchet files plus the body-shape pin, 35 passed under four profiles (full, analysis blocked with and without duckdb, full without duckdb). Not measured: the unnamed boot-sequence timer (boot_sequence.py:197) can still land in a walk window; routed as a finding, not fixed here.
